question_en:
I am a game animation instructor and need to create a list for drawing practice using the official character illustrations from the Nintendo 'Super Mario Party' character page. Based on all playable characters and their official illustrations listed on that page, please answer:

Which characters have at least one part of an actual hand clearly higher than the highest point of their head or headwear? Extensions by weapons, hammers, dice, or hair itself do not count; the hand holding an item must also extend beyond that highest point to qualify. Please provide a complete list covering all playable characters on that page, with each line stating the character name and a 'Hit' or 'Miss' determination; then list all characters labeled as hits and their total count.

The answer must include a complete itemized table of 'Character Name—Determination', followed by a Q&A section listing all characters labeled as hits and their count.
answer:

| --- | --- |
| Boo | Miss |
| Bowser | Hit |
| Bowser Jr. | Miss |
| Daisy | Miss |
| Diddy Kong | Miss |

| Dry Bones | Miss |
| Goomba | Miss |
| Hammer Bro | Miss |
| Koopa Troopa | Miss |
| Luigi | Miss |
| Mario | Miss |
| Monty Mole | Miss |
| Peach | Miss |
| Pom Pom | Miss |
| Rosalina | Hit |
| Shy Guy | Miss |
| Waluigi | Miss |
| Wario | Miss |
| Yoshi | Miss |

Q: Which characters are determined as "Hit", and how many are there in total?

A: Bowser, Rosalina; total 2.
